ecosystem: Uniswap / cross-chain DEX and tokenized-stock routing

risk_evidence.exchange_reserves: CryptoQuant-derived reporting puts centralized-exchange UNI reserves at a record 113.9M UNI. Binance alone held >73M UNI as of 2026-09-23.
risk_evidence.recent_exchange_inflows: Binance reportedly received ~2.6M UNI on 2026-09-18 and ~1.89M UNI on 2026-09-22.
risk_evidence.distribution: Wallet 0xA799 sold 788,000 UNI at ~$8.85 after buying at ~$6.26 less than a week earlier, realizing about $2.04M.
risk_evidence.interpretation: This is a material increase in immediately accessible sell-side inventory after a sharp multi-week re-rating and before/alongside CME futures access. Exchange-reserve growth is treated as distribution/crowding risk, not proof that all exchange-held UNI will be sold.

counterevidence.fresh_wallet_accumulation: Three newly created addresses accumulated 782,130 UNI (~$6.97M); two of them withdrew a combined 652,129 UNI from Binance, Gate, Bybit and OKX.
counterevidence.additional_buyers: 0xEFC4 bought 269,477 UNI (~$2.84M), and on 2026-09-24 wallet 0xd42B spent 1.5M USDC to buy 159,698 UNI at ~$9.39.
counterevidence.independence_quality: Mixed/partly unresolved. Multiple distinct addresses are visible, but funding/beneficial-owner independence and historically selective performance are not fully established.

protocol_and_market_state.tokenized_asset_usage: Uniswap reports handling ~80% of Robinhood Stock Token volume (> $10B cumulative in the cited report), >99% of Robinhood-chain DeFi stock-token deposits, >$300M of tokenized-equity volume on Base, and >$300M of Arc swap volume. Robinhood-chain activity remains discounted where prior incentive/synthetic-volume contamination applies; Arc/Base usage is treated separately.
protocol_and_market_state.value_capture: Protocol revenue and UNI-burn architecture remain active; current protocol use therefore still provides fundamental support despite reserve/crowding risk.

structural_gate.contract_security: No new honeypot, transfer restriction, privileged mint/freeze, deployer or LP-removal failure surfaced in this run.
major_caveats: Record centralized-exchange inventory increases potential sell-side liquidity.
Whale evidence is mixed: fresh withdrawals/buys coexist with a fast-profit 788k UNI sale.
Derivatives access/crowding is elevated after CME futures announcement and a large monthly price move.
Cross-chain protocol usage does not map one-for-one to UNI burn/value capture on every venue or chain.

rwa_assessment: Real tokenized-stock secondary trading and deposits are a genuine usage leg, but issuance/AUM is not counted as equivalent to turnover or collateral utilization. Robinhood-chain activity is specifically discounted where earlier incentive or synthetic-volume contamination applies. No new quantified borrowing/collateral-utilization leg was verified in this run.
decision_rationale: The record 113.9M UNI exchange reserve is a material risk-quality downgrade for an existing position already near the 7.5% non-core ceiling, but it is not sufficient for a trim because fresh wallet withdrawals and buys remain substantial, protocol fees/revenue remain strong, and Uniswap continues to lead multiple tokenized-asset and Arc routing markets. HOLD, no add and no trim. A trim becomes warranted if exchange inventory keeps rising while fresh-wallet accumulation fades, profitable-wallet distribution broadens, protocol revenue/value capture weakens, or price/holder persistence breaks.
forward_tests: Track whether aggregate CEX UNI reserves continue making new highs or begin reversing.
Track whether the fresh-wallet cohort continues net withdrawal/accumulation and check funding relationships/beneficial-owner independence where possible.
Distinguish sustained protocol spot/stock-token usage from derivatives-driven turnover and from any incentive-contaminated Robinhood-chain activity.
Watch protocol fees/revenue and actual UNI burn/value capture relative to exchange inflows.
Consider a trim if distribution becomes persistent across multiple selective/profitable wallets or price/holder persistence breaks while CEX reserves remain elevated.
